bedjet_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the Bedjet component.

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

ble_client_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the BLE Client.

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

time_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of a [Time](https://esphome.io/components/time/) which can be used to set the time on the BedJet device.

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to dispatch status changes to child components. Defaults to `5s`. Each child component can decide whether to publish its own updated state on this interval, or use another (longer) update interval to throttle its own updates.

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

extended.docs: Setting `hvac_mode=extended` uses BedJet "EXT HEAT" mode. Whichever is not selected will be made available as a custom preset.

heat_mode.docs:
**string**: The primary heating mode to use for `HVACMode.HEAT`  :

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

outlet.docs: The temperature of the air being discharged by the BedJet will be

temperature_source.docs:
**string**: The temperature that should be used as the climate entity's current temperature:

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

ambient_temperature.docs:
If specified, the temperature of the room the BedJet is in will be reported as a sensor. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*

outlet_temperature.docs:
If specified, the temperature of the air being discharged from the BedJet will be reported as a sensor. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [BedJet](https://esphome.io/components/climate/bedjet#configuration-variables)*
